### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

*arp-scan* is a network scanning tool that uses the ARP protocol to discover and fingerprint IPv4 hosts on the local network. It is available for Linux, BSD, macOS and Solaris under the [GPLv3](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html) licence. This is `README.md` for *arp-scan* version `1.10.1-git`. *arp-scan* uses the GNU *automake* and *autoconf* tools. The installation process from the latest *github* source is: - `git clone https://github.com/royhills/arp-scan.git` to obtain the latest source code. - `cd arp-scan` to enter the source code directory. - `autoreconf --install` to generate a configure file (if you don't have `autoreconf` you can download a tarball instead as detailed be
